## What would you like to do?

What are you trying to do, and what makes it difficult today?

## What would make it easier?

Walk us through how you'd like it to work. A sketch or an example from another
app is welcome. If it involves a server or archive, mention the type; keep
private addresses and file contents out of the example.

## Anything close already?

Have you found an existing Traverse command or another workflow that is close?

Take a quick look at the roadmap and existing issues so we can keep related
ideas together. You don't need a complete design to start a good conversation.
